sense.text:
Christ said “Watch and pray”: stay alert and keep praying, “that ye enter not into temptation.” Today is not Valentine’s Day; today is the Sabbath day, and the day of the destruction of Nicanor. Yet a lot of our people fall into the temptation. One sister pulls another sister back into the world, doing all manner of evil: birthdays, Valentine’s, Galentine’s. What the hell is Valentine’s Day? Our people will celebrate anything but what is in the Bible.

“the spirit indeed is willing”: you have woken up to this truth, you are keeping the commandments, you want to do what is right, and your spirit wants to go all the way. “but the flesh is weak.” That is why you have to pay attention, stay alert and stay prayed up. Don’t think you won’t fall into temptation, because a lot of the great men in the Bible fell into it.

February itself is named after the Roman purification festival, and the origins of Valentine’s Day are in Lupercalia, a Roman festival of animal sacrifices and goat-skin strips to purify the city and bring fertility. These months are named after idols, which is how you know we are in captivity. Black Hebrew Israelites will tell you that you can’t say the names of other gods, yet they say January, named after Janus, and February, named after this festival. So Valentine’s Day is idolatry, the same as Christmas, birthdays and Halloween.

What are we called to do with these idolatrous celebrations? “Wherefore, my dearly beloved, flee from idolatry.” This is in the New Testament. This is for you black Christians, you black apologists, you black pastors. Why would it be recorded in the New Testament to flee from idolatry if the law is done away with? Valentine’s Day is idolatry, believe that.

The Lord gave us our own high holy days. Last night at sundown began the day of Nicanor, the victory recorded in 1 Maccabees 7 and 2 Maccabees 14-15, when Judas Maccabeus defeated and killed Nicanor, the Seleucid Greek commander who came to crush Israel and threaten the temple. That is a victory over our enemies. Our people celebrate no victory over their enemies; instead they celebrate their enemies’ victories over us: the Fourth of July, Christmas, all these damnable holidays. Then comes Purim, when we were saved from being wiped out in the days of the Persian Empire, with Haman the enemy and the deliverance coming through Esther and Mordecai.

precepts.why:
1 Corinthians 10:14 goes right back to the law: “Thou shalt have no other gods before me.” When you sit up there and celebrate Valentine’s Day, you are putting Februa, Lupercalia or whoever the hell that is before the Lord. The same goes for all the rest of these idolatrous holidays.

Read on: “Thou shalt not make unto thee any graven image”, and “Thou shalt not bow down thyself to them, nor serve them: for I the Lord thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation.”

That is where flee idolatry comes from. Paul did not give a new teaching; he gave the commandment of Exodus 20 again. The law was not done away with, and idolatry still keeps a man out of the kingdom.

sense.text:
Remember: watch and pray. We are supposed to be alert, watching for the times to come, praying, keeping our spirit in order with the Most High and repenting. But “His watchmen are blind”. The watchmen are the black pastors, the Christian apologists, the ones supposed to be watching, like Jamal Bryant.

“they are all ignorant”: all of them, and I said it. “they are all dumb dogs”. When do you hear them go over prophecy? We are on the brink of civil war in America, and how many pastors are saying prepare for civil war, prepare ye war? None of them. They are celebrating Valentine’s Day.

“they cannot bark”: they will not prophesy and they will not warn you. They are like the dog that, when a man pretended to break into his own house, jumped out the window instead of barking. Most of the time they do not even see the danger in front of them, so they do not bark; they are too comfortable. “sleeping, lying down, loving to slumber”: silent and lazy.

Jamal Bryant preached with conviction that 85% of Jesus’ life he was wrong and out of order, and the people sat there and listened to it. That is a blind watchman.

“Yea, they are greedy dogs which can never have enough”. One pastor said nobody leaves until he gets his forty thousand; lock the doors. Another said if somebody sows a seed of ten thousand right now he will be a millionaire overnight. All they speak about is prosperity. You hear nothing about prophecy, nothing about warnings, nothing about getting your spirit right, nothing about repenting of idolatry like Valentine’s Day.

precepts.why:
Sin is the transgression of the law, the breaking and violating of God’s laws. So test what the pastor said, that 85% of Jesus’ life he was wrong. “Christ also suffered for us, leaving us an example, that ye should follow his steps: Who did no sin”. He did no wrong at all.

“neither was guile found in his mouth.” Yet a pastor will get up and speak against Christ, while you never hear them speak against Babylon, America. You never hear them speak against homosexuality or against all these idolatrous festivals.

That is why the watchmen are blind and dumb dogs: they speak against the Christ who did no sin, and stay silent about the sin all around them.

sense.text:
“Proclaim ye this among the Gentiles”: that is what the prophets go out to do. We are letting everybody know war is coming. “Prepare war”. Not only do we proclaim it among the Gentiles; our people need to know war is coming too.

How many of us are prepared for war? Be honest. Our people are not ready. While we argue, while you can’t get along with your wife or your husband, while you leave the Sabbath and go down there on Lamar picking up the damn lot lizards, our enemies are preparing. Our people want to be left alone, to get a bigger house with a thirty-year mortgage, instead of putting our money together to get three or four hundred acres of land and build our own. We are not thinking about war or about coming together, and if something pops off today it will be every man for himself, everybody running to their own house. The majority have nothing to defend themselves or their house with.

Vietnam is planning for a second US invasion, remembering the My Lai massacre and Agent Orange. The heathen are getting ready, and Israel is sitting still.

precepts.why:
Everybody just wants peace. You want to be left alone and live a good life. But you are in captivity; this is not our rest. The scripture says prepare war, because “To every thing there is a season, and a time to every purpose under the heaven”.

“A time to be born, and a time to die”: death is part of life. “a time to plant, and a time to pluck up that which is planted”. “A time to kill, and a time to heal”, and I’m just going to leave it at that. “a time to break down, and a time to build up”. “A time to weep, and a time to laugh”.

When you say a time to kill, Israel gets scared: I don’t want to hurt nobody. I don’t want to hurt nobody neither. Nobody is being told to go do violence. But the time is coming when you might have to defend yourself. Some of you are scared to go to jail; you a coward then. Be a man, brother. Somebody could kick in your door and rape your wife and your kids, and you could have had protection, but because you were scared you allowed it to happen. You want peace, you want to be comfortable, go to work, pay your bills and come home to your family for the rest of your life, while America destabilizes nation after nation. There is a time for everything, and that time is coming.

sense.text:
Negroes and black Hebrew Israelites say America is not Babylon the great. But America is the empire you read about in Revelation 17 and 18. Babylon the great is shown as a world-reaching power sitting on many waters, many peoples, nations and tongues, with global influence. What nation does that? America has military bases all around the world, their navy and submarines in everybody’s water. Who “sitteth upon many waters”? Who is always in everybody’s country causing global conflict and destruction? The US has launched hundreds of military interventions since 1798. You can’t tell me Babylon ain’t America.

The angel shows John “the judgment of the great whore”: a judgment is coming. Nobody wants this place to be judged. Their inward thought is that this kingdom lasts forever. The pride in Esau’s heart is so great that he says we are in the perfect place in the world, where nobody can attack us. Meanwhile they destroy a country and then bring the same people they destroyed over here. The pride of thine heart hath deceived thee.

What you see on earth right now is the multipolar shift: China has risen as a world power, Russia has risen, they are forming BRICS, and it is moving away from the singular dominance America once had. That is Bible prophecy. This place is prophesied to fall, and you can see it, but the pastors don’t know what to look for. We are the only ones prophesying, and whether they believe we are the prophets or not, we move and speak because the Lord moves us to speak. The prophets have his word, and we are going to go out and proclaim ye war.

precepts.why:
This is talking about Babylon, America. “Yea also, because he transgresseth by wine, he is a proud man, neither keepeth at home”. He will never stay at home; he is always in foreign lands. It is not the Arabs, not Saudi Arabia, not the Chinese, not the East Indians. Who else has the global influence to do these military interventions? Right now they are off the coast of Iran, ready to go to war.

“who enlargeth his desire as hell”: everywhere he goes, he causes hell. When he went to Vietnam and did the My Lai massacre, raping women and children as young as twelve, the largest confirmed massacre of civilians by US forces in the 20th century, he brought hell there. Agent Orange, and people are still dying from it to this day. Look what he did to Iraq. Look at Libya, where they are literally selling black people. Look at Palestine, and the proxy wars where he arms another nation with billions in weapons so he does not have to fight directly. Everywhere he goes he destabilizes the country and it becomes hell. Everything he builds is to destroy.

That is the proud man who neither keepeth at home: Babylon the great sitting on many waters.

“Thus saith the Lord of hosts; The children of Israel and the children of Judah were oppressed together”. You see that going on right now. Now Issachar is getting it too, even while they say, me no black, me white, and classify themselves as white Hispanic.

“and all that took them captives held them fast; they refused to let them go.” When Marcus Garvey had his ships and tried to take the Negro back to Africa, they sabotaged it. Nobody is installing a mass back-to-Africa movement. They refuse to let us go, and they take credit for our genius: the inventions, the light bulb that worked, the open-heart surgery done by a black man with hardly any training.

We were actively freeing ourselves from slavery, from Haiti to the plantations and the bayous of Louisiana, and they found it too expensive to keep us. They did not fight to set us free; it was a political move to make more money. If you don’t know who the wicked is on this earth, I don’t know what to tell you. Babylon is the captor that holds Israel fast.

sense.text:
“The vile person shall be no more called liberal”. These people are vile. Liberals are out there protesting, telling a black man, Nigga, you’re next, with the hard R. Whether they are Republican or Democrat, liberal or conservative, they are all the same, and they hate you. “nor the churl said to be bountiful.”

There is cyber warfare going on and propaganda pushed at an all-time high, saying the whole 13% of the population is responsible for all the crime. Meanwhile black people are choosing sides, liberal or conservative, instead of doing what the Lord tells us to do: repent and keep the commandments. These Negroes do not want to serve the Lord; they want to be left alone. Nobody gives a damn about you but the Lord, who sent his Son to die for you.

Now they are talking about civil war, and our people are not prepared. They have the turret guns, the fully automatic conversions, the gun and knife shows, while some of us are still mad at leadership over something said five years ago. We are supposed to be preparing ourselves mentally, physically and spiritually.
“Proclaim ye this among the Gentiles; Prepare war”: announce this to the nations. “wake up the mighty men”. Have we got mighty men in here? “let all the men of war draw near”.

“Beat your plowshares into swords”. The plowshare is what you use to do the work, and that is some of our brothers: all their mind is on is work, making an extra thousand dollars this week. The scripture says turn the tools of work into weapons, “and your pruninghooks into spears: let the weak say, I am strong.”

“Assemble yourselves, and come, all ye heathen”. All these heathen are assembling themselves and getting prepared. Vietnam is getting ready. Iran has built two thousand ballistic missiles since the twelve-day war and could have ten thousand by the end of 2027, and America has its army off the coast of Iran. Iran has got rid of America’s GPS systems and gone to China’s, because they are getting ready for all-out war. This is why we cannot go out and fight these people with guns like the New Black Panther Party: they fight with technology and cyber warfare, and you will not win.

“Let the heathen be wakened, and come up to the valley of Jehoshaphat”: the valley of decision. The Lord is going to gather all these nations together, and they are going to fight against each other. “for there will I sit to judge all the heathen round about.”

The Lord is saying prepare war. They are going to fight, and you need to prepare yourself physically, mentally and spiritually. That is not going out to fight; it is protecting yourself, your family and your friends. It is going down whether you want it to or not.

“The waters which thou sawest, where the whore sitteth, are peoples, and multitudes, and nations, and tongues.” So we know who this is talking about: America. Only America has global power and global influence like that.

“And the ten horns which thou sawest upon the beast, these shall hate the whore”. The ten horns are Belgium, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Germany, the United Kingdom, Italy, Greece, France, Denmark and Ireland. Denmark controls Greenland, and they are saying if Trump annexes Greenland, if America attacks a NATO member, it could be the end of NATO. Many of them say they can no longer trust America to protect them, and they are starting a European army of their own.

The horns are prophesied to turn on her: they “shall make her desolate and naked, and shall eat her flesh, and burn her with fire.” Her allies will turn against her, and everybody hates her even now, though they have to deal with her. The prime minister of Great Britain just went to meet with the Chinese to make a deal while America tries to isolate China.

“For God hath put in their hearts to fulfil his will, and to agree, and give their kingdom unto the beast”. Right now the European Union gives its kingdom to the beast through the North Atlantic Treaty Organization, sending NATO weapons and troops wherever she says. But that is only “until the words of God shall be fulfilled.” A time is coming when the horns will hate her, and we are watching it unfold before our eyes.

“Take ye heed, watch and pray”: we need to watch and pray. “for ye know not when the time is.” You don’t know when the time is coming, so you need to stay prepared and stay ready.

So watch and pray that none of us drift, get isolated, or get taken by sin and deception.

precepts.why:
Watch and pray for protection and deliverance, asking the Lord to fight against them that fight against us: “Plead my cause, O Lord, with them that strive with me: fight against them that fight against me.”

You can pray for that. These black Christians don’t know what to pray for.

Watch and pray for the destruction of the wicked devices of the enemy, that their traps, their plots and their lies be exposed and broken, and ask the Most High to show you. “Watch ye therefore, and pray always, that ye may be accounted worthy to escape all these things that shall come to pass”.

Pray for prophecy to be fulfilled, and pray that you are worthy to stand before Christ when these things come.

“the end of all things is at hand: be ye therefore sober, and watch unto prayer.” Be sober: keep a clear mind.

“And above all things have fervent charity among yourselves”. That is the brotherly love we are supposed to have, the way we are supposed to treat one another, because these things are taking place and we see them taking place on the earth.

Watch and pray for your household, your children, your brothers and sisters, because if the house fails, the nation gets weaker. That is why there are always marriage classes: it is not good for man to be alone, and two are better than one.

“Continue in prayer, and watch in the same with thanksgiving”. Be thankful for the things you have right now, because some people are in a far worse position than you.

sense.text: You have to prepare for war mentally. Wake up, stop being spiritually sleepy; now is not the time to be drifting. “knowing the time, that now it is high time to awake out of sleep”. With all these things going on in the earth, some of us are still asleep and not even paying attention. That is crazy. “for now is our salvation nearer than when we believed.”

Prepare ye war, and guard your mind from fear. “For God hath not given us the spirit of fear”, but power, love and a sound mind. Some of us are scared. Christ told Peter, sell your garment and buy a sword. Christ said do it, but some of us are scared even of that.

There is a time and place for everything under the sun, and that time is going to come. So prepare mentally, and guard your mind from fear, because God gave you power, love and a sound mind.

“Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour”. Stay sober and vigilant, because the enemy looks for open doors and distracted people. As soon as one of us gets distracted from the mission, they are coming.

Every time somebody leaves, the Christian apologist shows up, the devil, taking you all the way back into the world and having you speak all manner of evil. They are not telling you to prepare yourself for what is to come; they are only trying to destroy what we are doing. They say they are already saved, but you are not saved from the nuclear missiles that are about to drop.
“Take heed that no man deceive you.” Prepare ye war: prepare yourself mentally. Don’t let any man deceive you, and don’t let deception take you.

“For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.” He is telling you many false prophets and false Christs are going to rise. Think about the man online literally saying he is Jesus.

precepts.why: “For there shall arise false Christs, and false prophets”. That is going to happen, and it is already happening: men are rising up online claiming to be Christ. The deception Christ warned of in verse 5 is here, and preparing mentally means not being taken by it.

sense.text:
“If thou faint in the day of adversity, thy strength is small.” You have to be able to endure pressure. Prepare ye war by enduring pressure.

Don’t faint in the day of adversity. Trials expose your strength, and trials make you strong. Some of us do not want to go through any trials, but a trial will either expose your strength or expose your weakness, and when you learn your weakness you are supposed to fix it and do the things that make you stronger. Trial after trial turns you into a man. The main thing is to overcome and endure, to keep going.

Now prepare yourself physically. We have been telling you to stock up; if you are not stocking up, something is wrong. If you have not sold your garment to get a sword to protect your house and defend your family, something is wrong with you. We are a nonviolent people; all we want to do is serve the Lord, but we will protect and defend ourselves.

“Go to the ant, thou sluggard; consider her ways, and be wise”: look at the ant and consider her ways.

“Which having no guide, overseer, or ruler, Provideth her meat in the summer, and gathereth her food in the harvest.” The ant prepares ahead of time, and we have to start preparing ahead of time. Be diligent like the ant and prepare ahead, because wisdom stores up for hard seasons.

“How long wilt thou sleep, O sluggard?” Prepare ye war. This teaching is not only for those who are with us; it is for all our people. Repent, get your spirit together, prepare, and flee this damn wicked-ass idolatry. Talking about some Galentine’s Day: you feminists ain’t getting the kingdom of heaven. You ain’t coming into our kingdom with men ruling it. Rome failed when it started serving the women, and here Esau is serving the women again, and the country is declining rapidly.

Silver went to $120 an ounce last month and gold is $5,000 an ounce. For years brothers and sisters have been told to stock up, and silver was affordable. If the dollar crashes, if war happens and the banks close, what will you trade with?
“Behold an horrible vision, and the appearance thereof from the east”.

“Where the nations of the dragons of Arabia shall come out with many chariots”: that is Southeast Asia, Iran, which was the Persian Empire, with the East Indies. They will come out with many chariots, “and the multitude of them shall be carried as the wind upon earth”. It is coming for all the Arabian countries, and they will say this has to stop, let’s come together.

The Carmanians are the Iranians, and they are going to come out with great wrath and rage. Iran has told America and the world it will shut down the Strait of Hormuz, and if oil and gas go sky high, everything goes up, food included. They have said that every country hosting a US military base will be hit, that they will destroy every oil and gas installation, and they already showed what they can do when they hit the base in Qatar and whooped Israel in the twelve-day war. America is camped outside Iran’s shores right now, and we are waiting while everything is being put in place.

“For all nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her fornication, and the kings of the earth have committed fornication with her”. All the kings of the earth have committed fornication with America. Whenever you hear them talking about peace talks and negotiations, let’s see what policy papers we can sign, they are committing fornication right there.

“and the merchants of the earth are waxed rich through the abundance of her delicacies.” They control the trade and the dispatching of resources around the globe, and you can’t do anything without them. They took the Panama Canal and made China shut down its port there. Either isolate China, they tell everybody, or we isolate you. No other country on the planet controls this.

precepts.why:
“And the merchants of the earth shall weep and mourn over her; for no man buyeth their merchandise any more”. Who controls the global economy and global trade? America, through the petrodollar. That is why they have to keep the dollar powerful, and why, as the dollar falls, people are buying gold and silver: gold at $5,000 an ounce and silver at $80, higher than silver has ever been in history.

“The merchandise of gold, and silver”: they control that. When Ibrahim Traoré held gold, they said don’t touch it, don’t buy any of it, and now they are trying to kill him so they can take it all. They control the global movement of gold, silver, precious stones, and all the merchandise down to “slaves, and souls of men.”

When this empire collapses, global trade will be disrupted, because everybody comes to her. She controls the waters; America controls everything. That is the merchants weeping over her.

sense.text: “What? know ye not that your body is the temple of the Holy Ghost”. So prepare ye war physically: strengthen your body and keep it under control. “which is in you, which ye have of God, and ye are not your own”. You are not your own.

“A wise man is strong”. Some of you brothers can’t do ten push-ups. Brothers get upset because weight standards are set; you can’t run three, four, five miles, and you won’t get out and walk to save your life. How are you going to go out and teach the Bible fat as hell? A fat pastor once boasted he would eat people like you for dinner, and since he started with dinner, the answer was to deal with gluttony first.

“yea, a man of knowledge increaseth strength.” There is nothing wrong with diets and fasting, but you still have to exercise. Fast seven days and you might drop ten or fifteen pounds, but the Lord put self-preservation in your DNA, so your body starts storing water and fat and it comes back. Get out and exercise. You ain’t getting any younger.

Prepare ye war physically: strengthen your body and keep it under control, because your body is the temple and you must be fit to serve. How are you going to serve the Lord unfit?

“For God is not the author of confusion, but of peace, as in all churches of the saints.” Keep your house in order, because God is not the author of confusion, and order protects you in a crisis.
